exposure: HIV status (living with HIV vs. without HIV)
High-risk pregnancy conditions (e.g., hypertensive disorders, morbid obesity, diabetes)
outcome: COVID-19 disease severity (severe or critical COVID-19, ICU admission, invasive ventilation)
cohort: One hundred pregnant women (72 without HIV and 28 PLHIV) with high-risk pregnancies and laboratory-confirmed COVID-19, attending the high-risk obstetric service at Tygerberg Hospital in South Africa.
finding: In this cohort of high-risk pregnant women, COVID-19 had a severe impact, significantly increasing maternal mortality risk compared to baseline rates, and virally suppressed HIV infection was not associated with worse COVID-19 outcomes in pregnancy.
followup_time: Up to 6 months (from May 2020 to October 2020)
